Theorem
[Ricci-flat metrics and Perelman's $\lambda $ (Theorem 35.41)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0326 ↗ prop:chow-iv-perelman-lambda-second-variation 1. ch35:35.41\group Alternative Stability Methods

If a compact Ricci-flat metric $\hat g$ is a local maximizer of $\lambda $, then every sufficiently close Ricci flow exists for all time and converges, modulo diffeomorphisms, to a Ricci-flat metric near $\hat g$.
